findings.text: _held_reads compares Path(os.environ.get(_FOLLOWER_SOURCE_ROOT_ENV, str(import_root))).resolve() with self.source_root, which __init__ derives from the same environ default, so the two are identical whenever run() builds the reloader and the flag is a constant True; the named-root branch at :405 is unreachable and the comment at :370-374 says the post-reload read is answered from the tree when it is in fact held.

the mid-start deferral is part of the section's Deliverable but no assertion fails if _children_mid_start is deleted, because a child survives an exec and is re-adopted from the handover, so the gate cannot catch a regression there.

the pid-start-time refinement that refuses a reused pid is untested; no case exercises a mismatched pid_start, so the guard that stops the replacement supervising a stranger is exercised only on the passing path.

StationReloader is the repository's owner of replacing a long-running crew process with a proved image, and reckon/crew/session_host.py:340 _HostReloader duplicates that orchestration instead of extending or wrapping it.

the row added at a50cdb5d73 is labelled "base — importing tests" but gate/repair-base.log ran only tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py (58 passed), while the row at :53 labelled "base — tests importing the changed module" is the nine-file set at 60 passed; two near-identical labels report different sets and counts for bd0d2051db, so a reader cannot tell that the 62-vs-58 delta rests on a two-file arm.
